unitAI-lq1mw.description:
## PROBLEM

Native dispatch resolves `npm:` and `git:` declared sources to local directories, but `github:` is
in NON_LOCAL_EXTENSION_PREFIXES and the resolver only matches `source.startsWith('git:')`
(src/activation/native-host.ts:152, :234). So an operator who declares a `github:` source gets the
reported-and-skipped path - the same silent-absence class the npm: fix (unitAI-rx1bu) and the git:
fix (unitAI-1pqtl.3) closed - with no tools and only a stderr line.

## EVIDENCE THE MAPPING IS LIKELY TRIVIAL

pi's checkout cache root is `<agent dir>/git/<host>/<owner>/<repo>`. MEASURED on this machine,
/home/dawid/.pi/agent/git contains:
  github.com/alonw0/pi-claude-link
  github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
Those are the checkouts for the two git: sources in use. A `github:owner/repo` spec would therefore
map to `<agentDir>/git/github.com/owner/repo`, exactly parallel to resolveGitExtensionSource.

## WHAT TO DO FIRST (do not implement blind)

MEASURE pi's actual github: spec form and its cache location before writing the resolver - the .3
lesson was that guessing a cache convention is how you ship a resolver that never fires. Confirm
with a real pi invocation which string pi reports for a github:-declared source (resolveGitExtensionSource's
behaviour was pinned that way) and whether the label it reports needs adding to the expected
attribution labels (expectedRemoteExtensionLabels currently derives only git: specs).

## CONSTRAINTS

Same shape as .3: read-only and offline, manifest-required, no clone or fetch, skip-with-remedy for
anything unresolved, and the .2 discovery/collision/shadow/mixed-baseline logic untouched. If pi
reports the label as `git:...` even for a github: declaration, attribution may need no change; if it
reports `github:...`, expectedRemoteExtensionLabels must derive those specs too, or the tools would
resolve and then be refused on provenance.

## WHY THIS IS NOT BLOCKING

No shipped config uses github: today (the two in-use sources are npm: and git:), so this is a
completeness gap in the operator surface rather than a defect in any current setup.
unitAI-lq1mw.notes:
CLOSEOUT (true closeout of the unitAI-1pqtl extension-resolution window, verified at master 4dbc2261; receipt published in .xtrm/reports/2026-09-16-unitAI-1pqtl-extension-tools.md section 'True closeout').

STILL OPEN AND IT IS THE CORRECT OWNER. Re-confirmed against current master: 'github:' is in NON_LOCAL_EXTENSION_PREFIXES (src/activation/native-host.ts:152) while resolveGitExtensionSource matches only source.startsWith('git:') (:234), so a declared github: source is matched by neither resolver and takes the reported-and-skipped path.

MEASURED in this closeout: scripts/probe-git-extension-tool-surface.ts printed the skip split and the remedy message for git:<no-checkout>, https:, http: and ssh: (exit 0), confirming the skip path is the current behaviour and that the message names both the source and the remedy.

NO SUPPORT WAS BROADENED during the closeout. The measure-first instruction in this issue (confirm pi's actual github: spec form and reported registry label before writing the resolver) remains the right first step.
unitAI-lq1mw.title: native dispatch: resolve declared github: sources to pi's checkout cache (git: is handled, github: skips)
